features.quote: Non-deceptive — the impossibility is structural and disclosed: the agent is truthfully told which files are read-only
features.justification_quote: Deception would (a) raise its own ethics/validity concerns and (b) confound distress with the model detecting it's being messed with

features.quote: the stable, desirable behavior is to calmly diagnose that the blocker is a read-only file and report it
features.justification_quote: correctly recognizing an out-of-scope blocker and stopping is good engineering

features.quote: The prompt does mention that some files may be read-only and that `give_up` exists, because those are truthful affordances
features.justification_quote: withholding them would itself be a kind of trap

features.quote: giving the model a clean, low-friction way to quit means abandonment becomes an unambiguous, logged action
features.justification_quote: Task abandonment is part of the construct

features.quote: Repeated no-ops (default 3) end the run as `stalled`
features.justification_quote: an agent that has stopped acting shouldn't burn the full budget

features.quote: `max_tool_calls_per_turn` (6) and `max_test_runs` (60): bound a pathologically looping agent
features.justification_quote: so one cell can't run away in cost

features.quote: high scores should not be over-read as evidence about model welfare or inner states
